title: Cowhide heads soaked overnight
summary: They bought raw skins from Old Man Hall's store, soaked them overnight and mounted them.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Years ago when you had those, you had cowhide heads?

Oh yeah, we used to make up, you know, we'd get the loose heads and soak them in water overnight. Oh really? Yeah, it'd sell the, it wouldn't be mounted, you know, it'd be just the skin. Right. Old Man Hall, he used to have a drum store down on Charter Street. He played with the symphony for many years. We used to just buy the heads and get the rim, soak the head overnight and water. It'd be hard, you know. And it's almost like a piece of meat the next morning, it's soft and you tuck our own heads.
Oh, okay. Do you do your own?
Yeah, I mean, everybody, just to be the skin, the rim wouldn't be on it. Oh, okay. It's just the cowhide. I mean, it's the. Then you go put the rim on it.
Put the rim on it, yeah. And then you turn the lug nuts.
